scope: Read-only comparison of accepted V6.1/V6.2 generation, the surface-shape candidate, wrapper, and reusable judge/report tooling. No endpoint, image, judge, or publication call was made.

shared_contract.generator: GPT Image 2.5 / single reference / no grading

reference_assets.assessment: The candidate restores the pinned reference catalog and captions. Per-row reference IDs need not equal older runs because prompts differ and selection is model-authored; selected bytes must come from this pinned catalog.

blue_handling.basis: Candidate verification records byte-identical non-geometry system sections and unchanged non-replaced pipeline AST. The authorized support-shape/support-category constants are the only prompt-flow changes found.
blue_handling.cache_boundary: ReferenceBlue.VERSION remains old. The intended endpoint path uses the new default PIPELINE_VERSION unified-blue-scale-v20-surface-shape-r1. Do not use reference-blue cache mode for this run without a separately versioned decision.

candidate_and_wrapper.mask_semantics: The supplied matte is still created and used for product anchoring/guide construction; it is not sent as an image-edit mask. This matches both accepted baselines.
authorized_source_changes: hp3p/geometry.py: support_top_shape schema, ellipse construction/projection, and category-neutral geometry description
hp3p/pipeline.py: support shape/category instructions and PIPELINE_VERSION

findings.finding: The candidate manifest's runtime_tree_sha256 631fe047e7b82c6c690f038effda1155b0ffde5ecdbf8be745164db649a80de5 covers the 41-file code tree. Four reference artifacts were restored afterward; the current all-file runtime digest by the documented algorithm is dcddb85dbbb3dcb3faccba48b3427abf1d6806d04f1cef0880a7259c689c979e.
findings.resolution: The guide agent agreed to relabel 631fe047... as the code-tree digest and create a separate deployment manifest pinning all four reference artifacts, the 16-view bundle, and wrapper files. The runner should record that deployment-manifest hash.

findings.finding: ReferenceBlue.VERSION is intentionally unchanged and could reuse old reference-blue cache rows.
findings.resolution: Use the default PIPELINE_VERSION surface-shape-r1 branch for this run.

judge_and_report_reuse.usable_without_old_judgments: Yes, after collecting a fresh source manifest bound to the new generated-image bytes, unchanged twin bytes, new scene-prompt hashes, product types, and scene_generation stage. Run baseline V2 and compact V3 into new output directories, then recompute two-pass/consensus results. The old result files are input-hash-bound and must not be copied. The current surface report builder independently enforces source_prompts_sha256 and can render zero judgments as pending or accept a newly converted matching-source judgment document. The accepted V3 collectors/merge scripts contain old path assumptions, so this is reusable protocol and code, not a zero-configuration command against the new run directory.

release_assessment: No unintentional generation-contract change was found beyond the approved support geometry/category wording. Launch is parity-safe once the new deployment manifest pins the restored reference assets and the runner records that manifest hash.
